title: The platform owner reads the problem-report inbox on QA: list, review items, one report, refusals (read-only)
description: The platform administrator reads the inbox of problem reports (200), the list of review items (200) and, when a report exists, one report with its thread; a filter or a class that the inbox does not know is refused (400) and an unknown report id answers 404. A company administrator is refused the inbox and the decision route (before anything runs) with the fixed 403; a caller without a sign-in gets 401. NOT automated, on purpose: deciding a report, adding a comment (JSON or with screenshots) and changing the state of a review item act on REAL reports of real companies, notify the reporter and cannot be undone (there is no delete), and the runner would have to create a report first as a company user (that sends a notification to the owner of the platform); they are covered by test/letflow/routers/platform_problem_reports_test.exs and platform_owner_items_test.exs. Reading the screenshot route needs a report with an image: not available on QA. If the inbox is not configured on the build, the list answers 503 'Problem reports are not available.' and the first step fails with that answer: that is a QA configuration fault, not a scenario fault. Nothing is created or changed, so there is nothing to clean up and no residue; the fixture tenant is not needed.

steps.says: The owner reads the problem-report inbox (open reports, first page): 200 with the list. The first report id is remembered when there is one.
The owner reads the list of review items (class review): 200.
A status filter the inbox does not know is refused: 400.
A class the inbox does not know is refused: 400.
One report with its thread: 200 and the same id (only the id is asserted; the text of a company's report is never copied into the log).
A report id that does not exist: 404.
A company administrator is refused the inbox with the fixed 403.
A company administrator may not decide a report: refused before anything runs (the id is a fresh random one, nothing can change).
Without a sign-in the inbox is refused: 401.
